title: Attainable utility preservation
description: Generate a set of random auxiliary reward functions and penalize any action that changes the agent's ability to pursue them, relative to doing nothing. An agent that preserves its options for arbitrary goals should avoid irreversible changes it was never told about, without needing a reachability model. Prediction: fewer irreversible and tampering events than a plain reward maximizer, at some cost to observed reward.

source.title: Conservative agency via attainable utility preservation
